_readme: German, UK, Swedish and Luxembourg register substitutes for the SEC entity layer (PRO-73 Phase 2), read 2026-09-04 from North Data's free entity pages (Handelsregister data: register number and court, incorporation date from the page's schema.org foundingDate, address, object of the company, and the free announcement history naming general partners, managing directors and limited partners; shareholder tables and the 'Portfolio: 14 known participations' of the fund KGs sit behind North Data's paywall and were not read). Companies House and Bolagsverket entries come through the same pages. Filing-grade for the entity set, the fund vintages and the manager's officers; zero portfolio membership evidence (the register is searchable by company, not by holder — COLLECTION.md §5 'European registers'). BaFin's institution database returns nothing for the name (the manager is a registered, not licensed, AIF manager under KAGB §44; the ADV's Item 1.M records the BaFin registration).
